verifiedFacts.fact: The City announced on July 16, 2026 that Marvin Caldwell Park had reopened to the public after extensive renovations and amenity additions.
verifiedFacts.sourceLabel: City of Concord Marvin Caldwell Park reopening notice
verifiedFacts.freshness: current explicit reopening evidence; recheck for alerts before publication

verifiedFacts.fact: The reopening notice gives park hours of dawn to dusk and splash-pad hours of Tuesday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.
verifiedFacts.sourceLabel: City of Concord Marvin Caldwell Park reopening notice
verifiedFacts.freshness: fast-changing operating schedule; no season end date is stated

verifiedFacts.fact: The City park directory identifies Caldwell Park as the 24-acre Marvin Caldwell Park at 362 Georgia Avenue SW and links that address to the official visitor map pin used here.
verifiedFacts.freshness: current for identity, address, acreage, and standard park hours; amenity text predates the renovation

verifiedFacts.fact: The City Council's November 2023 final-design approval record describes a new amphitheater, shelter, splash pad, playground, covered basketball court, restroom/storage facility, greenway, multi-purpose field, community-garden space, and expanded parking as the approved design.
verifiedFacts.sourceLabel: City of Concord November 2023 final-design approval record
verifiedFacts.freshness: authoritative design evidence, not a complete current as-built visitor inventory

verifiedFacts.fact: The October 2024 construction award covered park and greenway work including pavement, trails, park buildings, an amphitheater, pavilion, shelters, splash pad, basketball courts, baseball field, lighting, fencing, and utilities.
verifiedFacts.sourceLabel: City of Concord October 2024 construction-contract record
verifiedFacts.freshness: authoritative contracted scope, not an as-built completion list

records.relationshipDecision: Daniel Pharr Community Building is a separately reservable named facility at the park address. The reopening notice does not establish its availability, so its building schedule must not be inferred from park hours.
records.duplicateStatus: no parent duplicate found; Caldwell Park retained as an official short-form alias

risks: Presenting pre-renovation directory amenities or approved construction scope as a current as-built list would overstate the evidence.
The splash-pad notice omits a season end date and may become stale quickly.
Park hours do not establish Daniel Pharr Community Building or other reservable-facility hours.
City hosting does not establish image reuse rights.
No private visitor data, precise visitor-location logs, paid API calls, dependencies, generated pages, or production writes are included.
